## Codex implementation handoff
Implement only the approved scope. Inspect existing patterns before editing. Do not commit secrets or modify Cloudflare, Resend, Zoho, or deployment configuration unless the ticket explicitly requires it. Run applicable tests, explain any tests not run, and open a pull request referencing this issue (e.g., "Closes #123"). Do not merge automatically.
